title: Missing admin input sanitization
summary: ## Severity  **Likelihood:** Low, because it requires a malicious/compromised admin or an error on admin side  **Impact:** High, because important protocol functionality can be bricked  ## Description  It is not checked that the `claimTimeout` property in `LP.sol` both in its setter function and in `initialize` does not have a very big value. Same thing for the setter function of `withdrawTimeout`. Also, the `checkFee` method in `LP.sol` has a loose validation - the max sum of all fees should be much lower than 100%.
